results.title: 🔴 North Korea arms exports to Russia nearly doubled to $14.4B; new land bridges enable trade split North Korea opened road bridges with Russ
results.description:
🔴 North Korea arms exports to Russia nearly doubled to $14.4B; new land bridges enable trade split

North Korea opened road bridges with Russia in September and China last week, operationalizing a new strategy to balance Moscow and Beijing without requiring geopolitical conflict between them.
North Korea-Russia arms trade grew from $7.7 billion in 2023 to $14.4 billion in 2025. The land bridge will strengthen bilateral weapons transfers while North Korean laborers work in Russian drone factories and along the Russia-Ukraine border.
